messages:
sam: FYI console alert — big jump in compat.fallback_rate around 00:10 UTC. looks like a batch of older clients are being hard-routed to v2 fallbacks :eyes:
ana: saw it, digging into route logs. linking dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/d/compat-rollups?orgId=1 :mag_right:
michael: did the fallback_threshold change we merged last week land? thought we set it to 0.95 for stricter fallback.
sam: we did `fallback_threshold: 0.95` in the rollout, but metric shows many tokens still considered incompatible — could be header coercion or seqlen mismatch.
tara: quick samples show `x-client-proto: v1`, `x-model: redwood-base`, and route chose fallback -> v2-shim. payloads contain legacy metadata fields.
nana: pulling routing snippet from prod-config: ```routing:
  prefer_v2: false
  fallback_threshold: 0.95
  header_precedence:
    - x-client-version
    - x-api-key```
michael: with `prefer_v2: false` + 0.95 we get noisy fallbacks when header signal is weak. threshold calc unstable.
sam: propose temporarily smooth the compatibility signal (moving average window ~30s) so tenant-level decisions don't flip aggressively.
tara: also suggest exempting high-throughput tenants from the new threshold until signal stabilizes. add console tag "grace_exempt" per tenant.
nana: UX note — rollouts page only exposes numeric threshold. ops wants a toggle: "apply smoothing" + tooltip. can we ship quick?
michael: backend change accepts `fallback_smoothing: {window_seconds:30, method: ema}`. frontend shows toggle + preview of effective fallback rate.
nana: ops-bot indicates deploy "deploy-service v2.14.1 -> routing-config update" at 23:58 UTC. maybe hold rollback.
sam: don't rollback yet. plan: set `fallback_threshold` back to 0.90 for 10m for affected tenants, enable `fallback_smoothing: ema(0.2)`, watch `compat.fallback_rate` and `latency.p95`.
tara: applying to tenants @high-volume-prod and @billing-prod now.
nana: can we auto-notify customers via contract-aware banner to reduce support noise?
michael: yes, console notify API: ```POST /api/notify-change
{ "tenants": ["high-volume-prod"], "msg": "compatibility fallback threshold adjusted for stability" }```
ops-bot: alert cleared, routing-fallback spike reduced after partial config change.
infra-bot: metric retention window updated to 2m for compatibility score series to support smoothing.
sam: follow-ups: ana -> add smoothing backend + CI tests; michael -> add notify hook to rollout page; tara -> list tenants flipped; nana -> UX toggle + tooltip copy.
nana: draft tooltip: "Smoothing averages recent compatibility signals to reduce noisy fallbacks. Use when clients have intermittent header/seqlen divergence."
michael: sync in 30m. if stable after 15m we can promote smoothing to default for beta cohort.
sam: :thumbsup:
